mentions.name: LLM Painting API
mentions.description: This is an API that a text-based LLM can use to make paintings. Built as an experiment, it explores what an LLM chooses to paint when told to paint unprompted, reveals the weaknesses LLMs exhibit when painting, and examines how fixing those weaknesses can strip away soul and 'happy little accidents' from the resulting paintings.
mentions.problem: Text-based LLMs have no native way to create paintings, and their painting weaknesses and their effect on the artwork's character are not well understood.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an API that a (text-based) LLM can use to make paintings. It is a fascinating experiment, what an LLM determines to paint if just told to paint unprompted, what the weaknesses of an LLM are, and how solving these weaknesses also remove some soul and 'happy little accidents' from the paintings.
